recognize_zh: 左側為大片淡染、細顆粒狀的無細胞壞死區，右側交界處有一層細長核、朝壞死排列的上皮樣組織球，再外為含小血管與紅血球的纖維組織；壞死區與柵欄狀組織球層清楚分界，符合壞死性肉芽腫。
features: Extensive acellular, pale, finely granular necrosis occupying half of the field
Band of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated nuclei palisading along the necrotic edge
Scattered karyorrhectic nuclear fragments at the interface
Outer fibrous tissue with small vessels, erythrocytes and scattered lymphocytes
describe_en: Intermediate-power H&E shows extensive acellular, pale, finely granular necrosis sharply bordered by a band of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated nuclei palisading along its edge, with scattered karyorrhectic debris at the interface. Beyond the histiocytic layer there is fibrous tissue containing small vessels, erythrocytes and scattered lymphocytes. No giant cells, atypical cells or organisms are seen. Findings are consistent with a necrotizing granuloma, compatible with cat scratch disease; stains for acid-fast bacilli and fungi, and Bartonella studies, are recommended.

ddx.vs: Caseating granulomas typically contain Langhans giant cells and acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
GMS/PAS stains show fungal organisms within the necrotic center.
Viable atypical lymphoid cells at the edge of necrosis and a monoclonal immunophenotype favor lymphoma over granulomatous inflammation.
